reference.title: Choosing unmanaged object storage
reference.shortdesc: Unmanaged storage is Red Hat Quay object storage that you provide and manage externally, such as AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or self-hosted S3-compatible services. You use unmanaged storage when you need to connect to a specific storage provider that you manage yourself.

section.p: Red Hat Quay supports the following major cloud and on-premises object storage providers:
For a complete list of object storage providers, the Quay Enterprise 3.x support matrix.

For example configurations of external object storage, see Storage object configuration fields, which provides the required YAML configuration examples, credential formatting, and full field descriptions for all supported external storage providers.
